scope: Installed receiver identity boundary and retained iteration16 raw packets only. No production/recorder/SDK edits, model/service launches, network access or new behavioral tests.
method: Read installed Python/typing sources and extract FileDescriptorProto directly from the generated module AST byte literal using google.protobuf.descriptor_pb2; no livekit native/client import. Compare retained packet metadata and source-hashed posthoc review. Existing tests were read, not rerun.
conclusions: The two recorded empty strings were read directly from DataPacketReceived.participant_identity before the Python SDK performed participant lookup. They are not merely a nonempty native identity hidden by a missing public RemoteParticipant.

The SDK public participant is a dictionary lookup result, so None alone can mean a late/unmapped identity or server-originated data. The native field distinguishes nonempty-but-unresolved from blank-at-this-boundary; it does not identify why native provided blank.

The installed data packet schema exposes no alternate sender SID, participant handle, source-authentication flag or globally bound event ID. room_handle scopes the receiving room; OwnedBuffer.handle/data_ptr manage payload storage. Neither identifies a sender.

participant_identity is a proto2 required string but may be empty. The stub explicitly documents empty identity for server SDK data. Current recorder did not retain HasField/IsInitialized or full serialized FFI metadata, so explicit-empty versus absent-required-field/default cannot be reconstructed from these receipts.

The current rejection is correctly bounded for trusted participant-attributed coordinator events. Buffering helps only when a nonempty native identity can later resolve to that same mapped agent. A later or sole agent, matching payload, topic, timestamp, event sequence or room name cannot safely supply a missing identity.

All raw bytes remain available, and separate posthoc comparison accounts for both missing promoted events as initial listening payloads. Trusted session_started arrived before readiness/input. Keep both full trusted trace equality failures; do not label these received packets as proven transport loss.

No safe receiver-only promotion fix is supported by the exposed fields. The observed ordering is compatible with a native/server participant-readiness boundary but does not prove that cause or identify the native/wire location that lost identity.

trust_boundary.available_when_blank: Room ownership, payload bytes/topic/kind and local receipt times; no attributable participant identity.
not_authentication: application JSON fields or payload equality

source_references.supports: Shim reads native participant_identity before calling the original synchronous SDK handler, then restores prior state.
Attribution records raw bytes and public/native identity; blank native identity is rejected, known nonempty identity waits for exact participant-kind resolution.
Recorder uses the reviewed Room source hash and bounded pending packet/byte limits.
Lookup uses room.remote_participants; participant_connected resolves only that exact identity.
Native bytes are parsed into FfiEvent; the callback does not check IsInitialized here.
Public DataPacket carries payload/kind/participant/topic; None is documented for server SDK sends.
Room loop filters by room_handle and processes the room event; room ownership is not sender identity.
participant_connected creates the room map entry before emitting its callback.
User data buffer copied/disposed; public participant comes only from dictionary lookup of native participant_identity.
Lookup returns None when identity absent from map; map creation keys on participant.identity.
Callbacks are invoked synchronously, preserving shim lifetime during the recorder callback.
Participant SID, identity and kind exist on mapped participant objects; no packet-to-SID fallback is provided.
publish_data sends via local participant handle and payload/topic; Python has no explicit sender_identity override.
UserPacket contains data and topic, no sender SID or authenticated source flag.
DataPacketReceived contains kind, participant_identity, user/sip_dtmf. Identity can be empty for server SDK data.
Serialized installed descriptor confirms proto2 required string identity; required does not mean nonempty.
Application publishes coordinator events from ctx.room.local_participant to agent-events; this code is not a per-packet proof of the missing field cause.
Existing fixtures separate nonempty-but-unresolved identity from blank/nonagent/sole-agent spoof cases.
Existing installed-SDK handler fixture covers a nonempty unresolved identity, buffer copy/disposal and synchronous callback; blank native protobuf case is not this fixture.

limitations: The installed Rust/native implementation and server wire path were not inspected or executed; Python/protobuf source establishes exposed fields, not why they were blank.
The historical recorder omitted proto presence/kind/native serialized event receipts, so those values cannot be inferred retroactively.
Existing source-hash guard covers the reviewed Room handler; private SDK compatibility is version/source bounded.
This investigation makes no change to iteration17 frozen production/configuration/recorder or its cache-comparison criteria.
